review.limitation: Cases and proposed labels were authored and reviewed by one reviewer (project owner) during milestone development. No second independent human annotation has been collected; scripts/review_cases.py generates a blank second-reviewer sheet and data/review/adjudication-template.md defines the pending process. Treat all labels as exploratory single-reviewer annotations.

invalid_input_summary.note: Expected-invalid cases are rejected by schema construction for every condition before verification; they are not verifier detections and never write memory.

timing_breakdown.note: preparation_ms is representation construction (graph build / text serialization); verification_ms is verifier execution only; latency_ms is end-to-end per case. Values are means over rows where instrumentation was recorded.

estimated_cost.note: No paid model calls were made for this condition (rules verifier). Estimated monetary cost is 0.00 USD for the run and no token usage was incurred.

faulty_detection.note: Precision/recall are over cases with an available decision (completed or invalid_input); execution/verifier errors are excluded from precision/recall and reported as error_rows. fail_closed_recall treats error rows as non-detections. Faulty means expected_decision is HOLD or INVALID_INPUT.

invalid_input.note: INVALID_INPUT is a construction failure recorded before verification: no ACCEPT/HOLD decision and no memory write. It is neither a verifier detection nor an execution error; expected-invalid rows are handled separately from precision/recall.

graph_vs_text.note: Counts and lists only; with 36 single-reviewed synthetic cases no statistical superiority claim is made. Differences indicate verifier-construction differences on identical inputs.

interpretation: Exploratory case-level rates on a small synthetic single-reviewer set; not population estimates. Labels were authored by one reviewer and second human review is pending. Condition rates are reported both as-completed (verifier errors excluded from numerator and denominator) and as fail-closed intention-to-treat (non-accepting error outcomes retained; explicit HOLD detection and error-hold counts reported separately). Precision/recall for faulty detection and the invalid-input section are additive views; INVALID_INPUT rows are construction failures, not verifier decisions. No statistical superiority claim is supported by this set.
